events.title: Back-to-School Scavenger Hunt
events.description: So long summer, hello new school year!  Stop by the library to find school related images hidden around the children's area. Find them all and win a fun prize! This activity is for children aged 4 to 12 years. *Please note that this a passive activity, not a program facilitated by staff. *

events.title: Fairy Scavenger Hunt
events.description: Fairies are visiting Fort York Branch!  Join in the fun and see how many fairies you can find around the branch. Name each item that the fairy is resting upon, identify the circled letters and then decode the secret message from the fairies.  Scavenger hunts support letter awareness and spatial awareness, and of course, are fun for all! Receive a free prize for completing the scavenger hunt.

events.title: Knitting and Crochet Circle
events.description: Spend an afternoon at our weekly drop-in knitting and crochet circle! Bring your work in progress and enjoy visiting with other knitters and crocheters. A great place to show off your work, get advice, swap ideas, or just relax and visit with fellow fiber enthusiasts. Beginners and all ages welcome! A limited supply of materials will be available.

events.description: Ages 9-12 Piskel can be used to create game sprites (i.e., 2D images overlaid onto a scene), animations, pixel-art for social media, etc. This software gives you the ability to paint and erase pixels, resize pixel art to a bigger scale, create animation sheets for games, and more. events.title: P.A. Day Movie: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants
events.description: Before school starts, join us for an afternoon screening of The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants (2025). Hoping to prove his bravery to Mr. Krabs, SpongeBob follows a mysterious, swashbuckling ghost pirate known as the Flying Dutchman on a seafaring adventure that takes him to the deepest depths of the ocean. Runtime: 1 hour and 29 minutes For children aged 0-12 and their families. Children under the age of 6 must be accompanied by an adult. Drop-in, no registration required.

events.title: Wildlife Activity Stations with Toronto Wildlife Centre
events.description: In this program, navigate your way through various wildlife-themed stations that feature hands-on activities about wildlife behaviours, threats wildlife face and how to coexist with our wild neighbours peacefully. Learn how to coexist with coyotes, why oil, water and birds don’t mix, whether you can keep a wild animal as a pet, how to create wildlife habitats, how to make windows safe for birds, and more! This program is intended for ages 5-12. Registration opens Friday, Aug 21st  at 9 AM.

events.description: Explore creativity and technology using Makey Makey! Keep an eye on the seasonal leaderboard as you earn points and work your way toward the top! Perfect for ages 8 to 12.
